title: Surreal Cosmic Portal
description: A circular stone portal frames a swirling blue vortex leading to a miniature fantasy world. Inside, a skeleton in a brown robe rows a green boat with a flaming torch while two figures in green robes stand on lily pads, one holding a red heart. The portal is overgrown with colorful flowers, vines, and potted plants, set against a starry night sky with a ringed planet, comets, and dragonflies. In the foreground, cracked ground features red poppies, mushrooms, and two smiley-face emojis in a purple puddle.
